title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Could Fix Major Timeline Holes
seoTitle: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Could Fix Timeline Holes
subtitle: The new Switch 2 version promises deeper dialogues and potential saga timeline fixes.
excerpt: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 features deeper dialogue and characters, offering a chance to fix major timeline inconsistencies.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The November 5, 2026 release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 has raised expectations that Nintendo will resolve the saga's biggest timeline issues. The original game, released for the Nintendo 64, was already considered the starting point for the division into three timelines, but the lack of clarity left fans confused about the chronology of subsequent titles, such as Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom.

What Changed in the Remake's Story

With the confirmation that the remake will feature deeper dialogues and characters, content creators have speculated that the new version may include additional dialogues with the sage Rauru in the Temple of Time. This could explain how Link's death in Ocarina of Time generates the three distinct timelines and how the original timeline might have been altered by a desire for a definitive end to the evil that appears in A Link to the Past.

How Nintendo Can Close Timeline Gaps

An Estadão article describes two possible approaches: the first would be to include new dialogues from the sage that detail the vision of the future preventing Link from being defeated in his childhood, thereby creating secondary timelines; the second, more speculative, would be post-game content that unites the timelines before Breath of the Wild, perhaps as DLC or an expansion. Both solutions would need to address the coexistence of Ganon in multiple universes and the eventual fusion leading to the 10,000-year prosperity scenario.

The Context of Remakes in the Franchise

TechTudo highlights that the saga's 40th anniversary coincides with the release of the Ocarina of Time remake and that other games in the series have already received updated versions, such as Link’s Awakening on Nintendo Switch and Majora’s Mask 3D on Nintendo 3DS. The article also lists seven titles that, according to the website, deserved remakes, showcasing the interest in reviving classics for new generations.

What Fans Expect from the New Title

  • Deeper dialogues explaining the division into three timelines;
  • Possibility of an expansion that unites the timelines before Breath of the Wild;
  • Enhanced graphics that maintain the essence of the original games;
  • A narrative that connects the events of Tears of the Kingdom and the most recent games;
  • An experience that honors the franchise's 40-year legacy.

With confirmation that the remake will bring more narrative content, the expectation is that Nintendo will seize the opportunity to clarify the series' chronology and offer a more cohesive experience for fans.

With information from Estadão, TechTudo.
